{{Quote|Name the system.|[[Aeradin]]|<ref name="TSoF" />}}
The '''Rearqu Cluster''',<ref name="TEA" /> also known as the '''Rearqu 10 system''',<ref name="TSoF" /> was located in the [[Taldot sector/Legends|Taldot sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated between the [[Lantillies system/Legends|Lantillies system]] of the [[Lantillian sector/Legends|Lantillian sector]] and the [[Jeyell system/Legends|Jeyell system]] of the [[Roche sector/Legends|Roche sector]] on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which served as the dividing line between the regions known as the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] contained several [[Planet/Legends|planets]].<ref name="TSoF" />
